202A.7 / CHAPTER 7 OF 8

Attention → capital

Did the story bring buyers, or only posts?

Eight short chapters

01Price moves at the margin02Liquidity & price impact03Buy/sell pressure04Supply transfer05Early wallet flow06Momentum & acceleration07Attention → capital08Push, Hold or Fail

01Definition

Attention becomes market evidence when discussion is accompanied by observable trading activity.

02Why it matters

A mention count alone does not establish demand or explain its source.

03What to check

  • Source and exact token association
  • Attention and flow in comparable periods
  • Whether activity continues after the initial mention

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

Source evidence and market activity support the same research question.

Dangerous

Repeated posts are treated as proof of independent buying.

05Beginner mistake

Equating social activity with capital inflow.

06Takeaway

Compare attention with activity; keep causation open.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    Indexed mentions rise after a headline.

  2. 02

    Observed buy value stays flat in the comparable period.

  3. 03

    Attention increased; buying conversion is not demonstrated.

Try it on a token

See it in Meme Fast → Tweet

Open source evidence, confirm the contract, then compare flow in Inspect. RSS counts do not measure total engagement or unique buyers.

Go deeper

Even when posts and buying rise together, that does not prove the posts caused the buys. Indexed RSS can lag, and the original exposure → interest → visit → buy loop is a conceptual path, not measured conversion analytics.
